recorded.prompt:q-booking-assert: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-booking-assert: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-booking-assert: The page decides c. Lines 145-146 show `java Asserts` creating Customer[...discountPercent=1500], and lines 147-150 show `java -ea` throwing AssertionError. Lines 153-154: Surefire enables assertions for tests by default, so the check is absent from a production JVM started without -ea. Heading (line 132) and table row 294 generalise this.
recorded.prompt:q-invoice-currency-trace: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-invoice-currency-trace: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-invoice-currency-trace: The page decides b. Lines 55-56: a stack trace holds the frames on the stack when the exception is created, and the constructor that stored the null had returned. The trace at lines 45-49 shows only the 02:00 job's frames and main.
recorded.prompt:q-cache-ttl-warn: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cache-ttl-warn: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cache-ttl-warn: The page decides d. Lines 218-219: getProperty finds no such key and returns the default. Row 295: fallback when the key is absent, misspelt keys included. Line 259: logging a warning and carrying on would still run with the default.
recorded.prompt:q-pool-size-unparsable: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-pool-size-unparsable: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-pool-size-unparsable: The page decides d. Lines 261-263: 800ms stops the loaders with NumberFormatException, and a loader that catches it and uses the default turns the failure back into the silent default. Row 297: Properties.load stores the whole value '16 per node', which parseInt refuses.
